title: One Piece Season 3 Heads Toward Alabasta as Netflix Prepares Behind-the-Scenes Features
excerpt:
One Piece Season 3 is targeting 2027 with the Alabasta storyline.
Netflix is preparing new behind-the-scenes features about Season 2.
body_md:
Netflix is preparing the next major chapter of its live-action One Piece adaptation. The third season, titled One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta, follows Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates into Princess Vivi's kingdom, where their journey becomes entangled with a much larger struggle. The Alabasta storyline marks an important escalation for the crew on the Grand Line and draws on Eiichiro Oda's long-running manga.

The immediate promotional development concerns a new series of behind-the-scenes videos focused on how the second season was made. These features are expected to provide a closer look at the production choices required to translate the manga's unusual characters, locations and action into live action. They should not be confused with a new trailer or a confirmed premiere announcement for Season 3.

Netflix is targeting a 2027 release for The Battle of Alabasta, but no specific premiere date or narrower window has been announced. The suggestion that the behind-the-scenes rollout could precede a date reveal remains an expectation rather than a confirmed marketing schedule.

Several performers introduced earlier will take on larger roles. Mikaela Hoover portrays Tony Tony Chopper, Charithra Chandran plays Princess Vivi, Sendhil Ramamurthy plays Nefertari Cobra, Lera Abova portrays Nico Robin and Joe Manganiello appears as Sir Crocodile. Their characters will be central to the expanding political and personal stakes of the Alabasta arc.

The announced additions include Xolo Maridueña as Ace, Cole Escola as Bon Clay, Awdo Awdo as Mr. 1, Daisy Head as Miss Doublefinger, Emilio Sakraya as Koza, Omid Abtahi as Toto, Jamie Ward as Pell and Nabeel Khan as Chaka. Together, the casting announcements illustrate how many new alliances and conflicts the adaptation will need to introduce.

With its cast expanding and promotional activity picking up, the adaptation faces the challenge of maintaining the appeal of its central crew while telling a larger story. For now, the new production features offer an opportunity to understand the work behind the show, while the exact release timing and longer-term future remain to be confirmed.
